files.attempts.json: one row per graded attempt, with the memory write, the rewrite, any rejection and the ingest folded in. Derived from the jsonl; nothing new.
files.console.log: stdout of the run, if it was captured.
files.experiment.json: what the experiment was and how to read it.
files.skill-final.md: the procedure Cognee held when the run ended.
files.swarm-1789998106-metrics.json: the per-run summary the cross-run table is built from.
files.swarm-1789998106-series.json: the harness's own chart document: panels, annotations, axis decisions and a caveat per panel. deck/src/charts/Panel.tsx renders this and decides nothing itself.
files.swarm-1789998106.jsonl: every event, in order, with a `t` in seconds since the run started. The replayable record.
files.trees/: the package tree after every attempt, one tarball each. `closeness` and the v1 count can be recomputed from these.
files.DEMO-NOTES.md: what the run shows and what it does not: the comparison window (attempts 1-9, both arms equal), the warm-only continuation (10-11), why cold's arm ended and why that is fair, and the arm-asymmetry caveat.

comparison.note: both arms had equal attempts; every head-to-head claim comes from here

continuation.note: cold's arm ended at a9 on a transport failure; these are uncontested and are not evidence about cold
